A '''clone trooper''' and [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was present during the [[Battle of Thustra]] and was discussing strategy with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Tyr]] and a [[Tyffix]] inside the [[Thustra Republic command center|Republic command center]] when a suicide bomber destroyed the command tent and killed most present, including the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone officer]].
